instrument_type_details.notes: No fuel hedging program. ATSG is a cargo ACMI/CMI carrier - fuel risk is largely mitigated by reimbursement through ACMI/CMI agreements with customers (DHL, Amazon, etc.). Company does have interest rate swap instruments (required by credit agreement) but these are interest rate hedges, not fuel hedges.

warnings: ATSG is a cargo air carrier (ACMI/CMI operations via ABX Air, Air Transport International). Fuel cost is primarily pass-through to customers via ACMI/CMI agreements. Fuel risk largely mitigated by reimbursement through DHL ACMI agreement and charter agreements. Interest rate swaps ($121.5M notional) for interest rate risk only. No fuel hedging.
